name: actiongate
description: Public examples and metadata for the hosted ActionGate MCP endpoint. ActionGate is a pre-execution safety layer for autonomous agent wallets with focused MCP tools for risk scoring, transaction simulation, and policy enforcement before an agent executes an onchain action.

tools.name: risk_score
tools.description: Evaluate the risk of a proposed wallet or agent action before execution. Use this first when an autonomous agent is considering transfers, swaps, approvals, policy-sensitive API calls, or other actions that may move value or change permissions. Do not use it after execution as an audit log; it is a pre-execution scoring tool. The call is read-only and does not submit transactions, mutate policies, or move funds.

actor.description: The agent, service, or wallet operator proposing the action.

actor_id.description: Stable identifier for the acting agent or wallet operator, such as agent_ops_02.

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM wallet address controlled by or associated with the actor.

action.description: The proposed action to score. Include the action category and all known transaction or API details.

action_type.description: Category of the proposed action. Use other only when the action does not fit the listed categories.

network.description: Blockchain network for onchain actions, such as base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, or polygon.

asset_symbol.description: Asset symbol involved in the action, such as USDC or ETH.

amount.description: Decimal amount or smallest-unit amount, using the same units the caller will submit downstream.

target.description: Target wallet, contract, spender, or API endpoint for the proposed action.

context.description: Optional execution context that can improve scoring, such as balances, recent activity, allowlists, chain state, or treasury limits.

risk_score.description: Normalized risk score where higher values indicate greater risk.

risk_level.description: Human-readable risk tier derived from the score.

factors.description: Reasons that contributed to the score.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Estimate execution cost, failure probability, and notable side effects for a proposed action before execution. Use after risk_score when the agent needs operational detail such as gas cost, revert risk, balance impact, or warnings. Do not use it as a guarantee that a transaction will succeed, and do not use it to submit the action. The call is read-only and performs estimation only.

actor.description: The agent, service, or wallet operator proposing the action.

actor_id.description: Stable identifier for the acting agent or wallet operator.

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM wallet address controlled by or associated with the actor.

action.description: The exact proposed action to simulate. Include enough information to estimate cost and failure risk.

asset_symbol.description: Asset symbol involved in the action.

amount.description: Decimal amount or smallest-unit amount, matching the downstream transaction format.

target.description: Target wallet, contract, spender, or API endpoint.

context.description: Optional chain, balance, route, allowance, or treasury context for more accurate estimation.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated execution cost in USD when available.

failure_probability.description: Estimated probability that the action fails or reverts.

warnings.description: Simulation warnings or side effects the agent should consider.

tools.name: policy_gate
tools.description: Check whether a proposed action complies with a named policy pack and return allow, deny, or allow-with-limits before execution. Use after risk_score and simulate when the agent needs a final policy decision. Do not use this to create, edit, or delete policy packs; it only evaluates the supplied action against existing policy inputs. The call is read-only with respect to the target wallet and does not execute the action.

actor.description: The agent, service, or wallet operator proposing the action.

actor_id.description: Stable identifier for the acting agent or wallet operator.

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM wallet address controlled by or associated with the actor.

action.description: The proposed action to evaluate against policy.

asset_symbol.description: Asset symbol involved in the action.

amount.description: Decimal amount or smallest-unit amount, matching the downstream transaction format.

target.description: Target wallet, contract, spender, or API endpoint.

policy.description: Policy pack selection and optional override values for this evaluation.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy pack to apply, such as treasury_default_v1.

context.description: Optional context such as daily spend totals, allowlists, approval history, balances, or route metadata.

decision.description: Policy decision for the proposed action.

reason.description: Concise explanation of why the policy decision was returned.

limits.description: Any policy limits that apply when decision is allow-with-limits.

prompts.name: review_treasury_transfer
prompts.description: Guide an agent through ActionGate's recommended pre-execution flow for a treasury transfer: score risk, simulate costs and failure probability, apply policy, then return an approve or reject recommendation.
